author: Opentrons

With this protocol, your robot can perform the ROCHE KAPA HyperPlus NGS library prep protocol described by the [KAPA HyperPlus Kit](https://www.n-genetics.com/products/1104/1023/17277.pdf). This is part 2 of the protocol, which includes the steps (

steps.title: Bead cleanup of libraries
steps.instruction: Perform bead cleanup of the amplified libraries as described in the KAPA HyperPlus protocol.

steps.title: Pool the libraries
steps.instruction: Combine the cleaned‑up libraries into a single pool.
